metadata.title: Retro Pop Album Cover with Halftone Portrait

retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant 1960s-inspired layout featuring a duotone halftone portrait framed by horizontal rainbow stripes on a textured mustard yellow field.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition dominated by a warm mustard yellow background, featuring a framed duotone halftone image of two figures on the left, intersected by five horizontal stripes in orange, green, purple, blue, and pink that extend to the right edge.
coreVisualRelationships: The framed portrait acts as the primary visual weight on the left.
Horizontal stripes create a rhythmic connection between the image and the text list.
The bold slab serif title at the top balances the smaller metadata at the bottom.
High-contrast color blocking defines the hierarchy of information.
coreInvariants: Halftone dot pattern on the central portrait

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A vertical rectangular portrait occupies the left-center, scaled to approximately 60% of the height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, vibrant pink slab serif title at the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the title, moves down to the portrait, then follows the horizontal stripes to the right-side text list.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant mustard yellow space at the top and bottom edges provides breathing room for secondary text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mustard yellow background providing a warm, vintage base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep purple and blue tones within the halftone portrait.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant pink, orange, green, and cyan used in stripes and typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all accent colors against a medium-value yellow background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Title uses ultra-bold slab serifs with tight kerning.
Secondary text uses clean, all-caps geometric sans-serif.
Feature text uses a casual, slanted script.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'a' in title has a large, circular counter.
Ampersand is stylized and integrated closely between words.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy slab serif for impact paired with clean sans-serif for legibility within color bands.
graphicDevices: Thin cyan border around the portrait

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, rounded slab serif feel of the 60s era.
Provides the necessary weight and clarity for the secondary sans-serif text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a mustard yellow textured background. Place a vertical rectangular frame on the left with a cyan border. Inside the frame, place a duotone halftone portrait in purple and tan. Add five horizontal stripes (orange, green, purple, blue, pink) extending from the frame to the right edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large magenta slab serif title at the top left. Place white all-caps sans-serif text centered within each of the five horizontal stripes. Add a small script 'Featuring' above the stripes and metadata text at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait rendered with a visible halftone dot pattern?
Are the five color stripes perfectly horizontal and aligned with the text?
Is the title font a heavy, lowercase slab serif?
Is the background a consistent mustard yellow with slight paper texture?

adjustableVariables: Weight of the slab serif title
postGenerationChecks: Check that the halftone effect is applied only to the portrait.
Ensure the stripes do not overlap the portrait frame.
Verify the title is in lowercase slab serif.
Confirm the background texture mimics vintage cardstock.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a duotone halftone image with a vibrant color-blocked stripe system on a warm, textured neutral background for a classic mid-century pop aesthetic.
